newsitem.title: SPAIN: Cepsa cuts petrol price in line with Repsol.
newsitem.headline: Cepsa cuts petrol price in line with Repsol.

text.p: Spanish oil firm Cepsa has cut its petrol prices to the public so they are in line with rival Repsol, sources at the company told Reuters on Tuesday.
"We had to react. We have adjusted our prices so they are at the same level as Repsol," the source said.
On Monday, Repsol announced a cut of up to two pesetas per litre in its petrol prices.

The only exception to this change in prices would be the price of Cepsa's lead-free 98-octane petrol, where the price would fall by one peseta more than Repsol's cut in the same grade, the source said.
Profits would not be affected because expenses would be adjusted accordingly, he added.
"Let's see how long this lasts. In any case we're going to reduce our costs to the same degree, for example in advertising," he said.
